jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603 inventory: Springfield School District, a town school district that is its own supervisory district (member town: Springfield). Operates PK-12.

board.post_note: Springfield SD: five directors at-large under 16 V.S.A. section 423(a)-(b), elected by Australian ballot at the annual meeting for 3-year staggered terms.

sources.note: Springfield Official Returns of Votes (official): March 3, 2026 -- "SCHOOL DIRECTOR - 3 YEARS": Steve Geller elected (560 votes) over Boynton (236) and Stern (373); March 4, 2025 -- Jessica Austin (974) and Denise Hunter (970) elected. Town-district directors serve statutory 3-year terms (the 2026 ballot prints the term), so Austin's and Hunter's ends are 2028 (election + the ballot's term, as derived in the research). Current roster per the March 4, 2026 reorganization minutes and the 2026-27 Elm Hill handbook: Palmer (Chair), Karaffa (Vice Chair), Hunter (Clerk), Austin, Geller. Palmer's and Karaffa's term ends are published in NO fetched source (a district board-bios flipbook stating "2024-2027" surfaced only as a search snippet -- a lead, not used); resolving document: the March 5, 2024 Official Return. Jessica Cady-Burlew sat through Feb. 9, 2026, was not on the March ballot, and Geller took the seat -- recorded ended 2026 (a regular election transition).
